messages:
maria: Quick design review — updated legend/axis mocks in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/XXXX | TL;DR: trying a compact legend that prioritizes numeric value over units, and a unit hierarchy for mixed charts. Need accessibility + dev feasibility input. :eyes:

alex: Linking mock. My first pass: make units smaller and right-aligned, use lighter weight (600 value vs 400 unit?)

jin: Prefer numeric prominence too. Concern: small multiples — units could clutter. Suggest hiding unit inside tooltip for very small width (<80px) and exposing full unit on hover.

sam: Agree with hiding on cramped views. Also: smoothing should be opt-in for small charts. If we auto-smooth, visually indicate it (dashed line + legend badge `smoothed`).

olivia: Accessibility: ensure units are readable by screen readers. Proposal: render visible abbreviated unit (e.g., 'req/s') but add aria-label="requests per second" on the value span.

design-bot: Contrast scan: legend unit color (#7a7a7a) fails WCAG AA against white by 3.8:1 — target >= 4.5:1 for small text. Recommendation: move to #6b6b6b or increase font-size.

contrast-bot: Auto-suggested token: --text-muted-contrast: #6b6b6b

maria: Good catch. Can we keep visual lightness but meet 4.5:1? Jin/Dev thoughts on tradeoff with perceived compactness?

alex: Dev note: making units slightly larger is cheap; aligning units right requires small CSS change. Sample:
```
.chart-legend .value { font-weight: 600; }
.chart-legend .unit { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-muted-contrast); margin-left: 6px; }
```

jin: For axis labels, propose we keep SI shorteners (.2s) but append unit only on the axis title, not each tick. Example formatter:
```
formatTick = d => d3.format('.2s')(d)
axisTitle = 'Requests per second (req/s)'
```

sam: Outlier handling: current mock clips spikes in small charts. I'd rather fade extreme datapoints and show a small callout on hover with exact value. Clipping hides signal.

olivia: +1 to fade + callout. Also need keyboard focus target for callout (tab to series → tooltip appears). Add aria-describedby linking to callout content.

maria: Action items — I'll update Figma with:
- unit color -> --text-muted-contrast (#6b6b6b)
- smoothed badge treatment (dashed line + `smoothed` microcopy)
- unit collapse rule for <80px

jin: I'll add aria-label pattern and keyboard focus -> `valueSpan.setAttribute('aria-label','{value} {unitFull}')`

sam: I'll prototype fade vs clip and test with 1000-series render perf.

alex: I'll push a small CSS change PR after Figma update. :thumbsup:

maria: Thanks — back in a few hours with updated frames. :sparkles:
